name: 35233 · Birmingham, AL
findings: ZIP 35233 (Birmingham) has 82 nonprofit organizations. 47 of them (57%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 41 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 35233 (Birmingham) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
